question: This computer has no Node.js, so the standard build step cannot run; the site is delivered as ready-to-serve static files instead.
probes: Install Node.js on this computer if the person wants a build step in the future
resolution: Solved by not needing it: the site is plain HTML/CSS/ES modules with no compilation, and app/build.bat copies site/ to dist/ with xcopy. It ran successfully (exit 0). Node.js is only needed if the person later prefers `npm run build`.
